title: Camera registration
description: JSON body a camera POSTs to the registrar at /api/register when it joins the LAN. The registrar records the TCP source address as the camera IP. A body ip, if present, must match that address. The camera password is not part of this message.

id.description: Camera name, typically cambot- plus the last 4 hex digits of the MAC.

ip.description: Optional. Must equal the TCP source address the registrar sees.
